eras.label: Before time
eras.plain: Before the world was made. He was with the Father.
eras.markerText: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

eras.label: Creation and the first days
eras.plain: The world is made, and the first families live (Genesis 1 to 11).
eras.markerText: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

eras.label: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
eras.plain: Yahweh calls Abraham and makes the promise to him and his seed (Genesis 12 to 50).
eras.markerText: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

eras.label: Moses and the wilderness
eras.plain: Israel comes out of Egypt, receives the law, and walks in the wilderness (Exodus to Deuteronomy).
eras.markerText: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

eras.label: The land and the judges
eras.plain: Israel goes into the land, and judges lead them (Joshua, Judges, Ruth).
eras.markerText: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

eras.label: The kings and the psalms
eras.plain: Israel has kings; David sings the psalms (1 Samuel to 2 Chronicles, Psalms, the books of wisdom).
eras.markerText: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

eras.label: The prophets
eras.plain: Yahweh speaks by the prophets, before and after the exile (Isaiah to Malachi, Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther).
eras.markerText: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

eras.label: He comes in the flesh
eras.plain: He is conceived, born, and grows up (Matthew 1 to 2, Luke 1 to 2).
eras.markerText: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

eras.label: His ministry
eras.plain: He preaches, heals and teaches, from His baptism to the week of the cross.
eras.markerText: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

eras.label: The cross
eras.plain: The last supper, the garden, the trials, the cross and the tomb.
eras.markerText: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

eras.label: He is risen
eras.plain: He rises the third day and is seen for forty days.
eras.markerText: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

eras.label: He goes up into heaven
eras.plain: He is taken up and sits at the right hand of Yahweh.
eras.markerText: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

eras.label: The church
eras.plain: The Holy Spirit comes, and the witnesses carry His name (Acts, the letters, Revelation as written).
eras.markerText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

eras.label: He comes again
eras.markerText: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

eras.label: For ever
eras.plain: He reigns for ever and ever.
eras.markerText: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

tie.text: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
And the God of peace shall bruise satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

edge.reason: The seed of the woman who bruises the serpent’s head. The New Testament echoes it but does not quote or name it.

verses.text: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

tie.text: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

edge.reason: Shiloh and the sceptre of Judah. Revelation names Him the Lion of the tribe of Juda but does not quote the verse.

verses.text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

tie.text: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

edge.reason: A Star out of Jacob. He calls Himself the bright and morning star; the verse is not quoted.

verses.text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

edge.reason: I know that my redeemer liveth. No New Testament verse quotes or names it.

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

tie.text: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

edge.reason: The King of glory. Paul calls Him the Lord of glory; the psalm is not quoted.

verses.text: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?

tie.text: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

edge.reason: What is His son’s name? He says no man hath ascended up to heaven but He that came down; the verse is not quoted.

verses.text: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.

edge.reason: The verses after Immanuel’s name. The rule takes Isaiah 7:14 by Matthew 1:23 and stops there.

verses.text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

tie.text: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

edge.reason: The righteous Branch, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS. No New Testament verse quotes it.

verses.text: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.

edge.reason: The Branch of righteousness grows up unto David. No New Testament verse quotes it.

verses.text: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it.

tie.text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

edge.reason: One shepherd, My servant David. He calls Himself the good shepherd; the verse is not quoted.

verses.text: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

edge.reason: The fourth in the fire, like the Son of God. No New Testament verse names it.

verses.text: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

edge.reason: He shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD. Matthew quotes 5:2; the rule stops at what is quoted.

verses.text: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.

edge.reason: The desire of all nations. No New Testament verse quotes it.

verses.text: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.

edge.reason: My servant the BRANCH. No New Testament verse quotes it.

verses.text: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:

Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

tie.text: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

edge.reason: The man "whose name is The BRANCH" (Zechariah 6:12), "a priest upon his throne" (Zechariah 6:13). Hebrews speaks of the priest on the throne but does not quote the verse.

verses.text: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

tie.text: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.

edge.reason: His feet on the mount of Olives. He went up from Olivet and will come in like manner; the verse is not quoted.

verses.text: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

tie.text: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

edge.reason: The Sun of righteousness with healing in His wings. Zacharias speaks of the dayspring from on high; the verse is not quoted.

verses.text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

tie.text: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

edge.reason: The name at the bush, "I AM THAT I AM" (Exodus 3:14). He said, "Before Abraham was, I am" (John 8:58), and L196 reads the two together, but John does not quote Exodus, so the rule does not reach it.

verses.text: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

tie.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

edge.reason: Yahweh appeared to Abraham. He says Abraham rejoiced to see His day, but names no passage.

verses.text: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

edge.reason: Wisdom set up from everlasting. No New Testament verse names this chapter; held for the elders.
